artifactWaiver.reason: Implementation artifacts were never emitted for any of the seventeen Wave 1 slices — the Executor briefs omitted the ADR-003 requirement and the Review phase was bypassed, both orchestration errors. The telemetry those artifacts carry (phaseRunId, executionDurationMs, toolInvocationCount, TDD red→green evidence) is unrecoverable; producing PASS records would fabricate the evidence this gate verifies, and every Review agent was instructed not to and did not. A full retrospective Review pass over all seventeen slices was run instead on the merged tip fdb16f9a, verifying by execution rather than reading: sixteen PASS, one PASS_WITH_WARNINGS (#984), whose finding was a live boundary bypass (whole-module import plus attribute access evading the client guard) now fixed with regression tests rather than waived.
